public_definitions: The goal is to review the mountain snowpack temperature dashboard for the 2005-2015 review period, determine whether the full-period change requires substantial-change follow-up, then submit the appropriate routing decision.
The chart is to be used to determine whether the full-period mountain snowpack temperature change should enter substantial-change follow-up or remain in routine monitoring.

The options are: Route the 2005 to 2015 mountain snowpack temperature change to substantial-change follow-up, Keep the 2005 to 2015 mountain snowpack temperature change on routine monitoring for ordinary variation, Route the mountain snowpack temperature record to archive and background filing.
The routing criterion is whether the full-period mountain snowpack temperature change requires substantial-change follow-up.
